title: Ukrainian Beef Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Ukrainian dish featuring beef dumplings in a flavorful broth.

ingredients.name: Chewy Dumpling Dough
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought chewy dumpling dough

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, yeast, salt, black pepper, and caraway seeds. Mix well.
Divide the chewy dumpling dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the dumplings are cooked through.
Serve the Ukrainian beef dumplings hot in a flavorful broth.
To make the broth, combine 4 cups of beef broth, 1 tablespoon of tomato paste, and 1 teaspoon of dried thyme in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10-15 minutes.
